title: Enhancing Road Coordination Through Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) Communication
summary: OptM describes controlled pilots of vehicle communication and AI coordination. Safer journeys, smoother traffic, and lower emissions remain expected.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: OptM describes controlled pilots of vehicle communication and AI coordination. Safer journeys, smoother traffic, and lower emissions remain expected. Controlled road pilots.
purpose: Help vehicles coordinate safely on constrained roads.

ratings.reason: Drivers and other road users are intended to gain safer road coordination.
Smoother traffic and lower emissions are intended, without a measured public outcome.

ai_role.statement: The chapter describes this system as supporting the stated purpose. Its causal contribution to the benefit has not been separately assessed.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: Enhancing Road Coordination Through Vehicle-to-Vehicle (V2V) Communication

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Vehicle positioning, sensors, and interoperable V2V communication

headline: V2V coordination for narrow and congested roads

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
